statement: For every new hire, the employee must complete Form I-9 section 1 at the time of hire and the employer must complete the section 2 review and verification within 3 business days of the hire (8 CFR § 274a.2(b)(1)(i)(A), (b)(1)(ii)(B)).
caveat: Use the current edition of Form I-9; remote-examination procedures apply only to qualified E-Verify employers. This repo does not perform verification or determine document sufficiency.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (law-map 2026-10-14); independent domain expert review pending
